summary: Perf load runs on hetz2 take a kernel-lock slot with a timeout; scripts and docs only

rules.detail: No admission, authority or acknowledgement changes.

compatibility.detail: Only scripts/ci-perf outside CI changes: it defaults its CI variables and takes the slot on hetz2. CI behaviour is unchanged.

manual.detail: Builders on hetz2 run the same command; concurrent runs now wait in line.

recovery.detail: A killed or timed-out run frees the slot by itself.
